digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model tracing and observability
propositions: Each fallback candidate model must emit exactly one child OTel span under the parent Agent model-request span without duplication from instrument_all, recording zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, outcome from {returned, raised}, and optional provider-reported usage.

Candidate span wrapping via WrapperModel subclass at construction site in build_fallback_model must preserve fallback selection order, predicates, and the existing FallbackExceptionGroup without altering RunUsage, UsageLimits, pricing, or S2 _pai_structured control flow.

Sanitized error reasons on raised candidate spans must pass through sanitize_diagnostic to redact credentials, prompts, responses, and endpoints, with span-emission failures swallowed to ensure tracing-off and tracing-on result/usage/exception are identical.

The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must be legible as native attempt span raised then prompted attempt span returned, with both routing through the same wrapped candidates and zero change to _pai_structured.

Candidate span instrumentation must work correctly with tracing disabled, in lean-import mode without tracing extras, and with exporter/tracer failures, maintaining identical fallback behavior in all cases.
In-memory exporter tests must verify parent-span-id nesting, candidate order sequencing, outcome classifications, secret redaction, and paired before/after usage equivalence across tracing scenarios.
